Explore Financing Options From First Visit to Perfect Smile Before After Frequently Asked Dental Questions Over the years assisting patients with dental-related issues, we’ve answered countless questions about oral health, treatments, our dental practice, payment arrangements, and more. To save you time and trouble, we’ve responded to some of the more common ones here, but don’t hesitate to reach out to us if you have others or would like further clarification. How Do I Get Emergency Dental Care? We encourage you to call our dental office immediately if you have a severe toothache or another type of dental emergency. Our dental practice is equipped to handle many different kinds of urgent dental situations, and we can schedule a same-day appointment for you so that you can get the relief you need in a timely manner. Please note that you should call the nearest emergency room if you have a life-threatening issue such as a fractured jaw, swelling that’s interfering with your ability to swallow or breathe, or oral bleeding that won’t stop. How Do I Find the Best Place to Get Dental Work Done? There are many factors to consider when deciding if a specific dental practice is right for you, such as whether they take your dental insurance, whether they have hours that work with your schedule, whether they’re located near where you live or work, and what kinds of services they offer. Keep these factors in mind when researching a practice, and don’t forget that you can always check online reviews to get a better feel for the way that the dental team treats their patients. How Much Does a Dental Checkup & Cleaning Cost in Goodyear, AZ? In the United States, the cost of a dental checkup and cleaning often falls between $200 and $350. Of course, there’s no “set in stone” answer since the amount you pay can end up varying depending on the dental practice you visit as well as how healthy your mouth is in general. Keep in mind that if you have dental insurance, you can typically expect your plan to help pay for biannual checkups and cleanings; in fact, some dental insurance companies may even be willing to fully cover these appointments. What Do You Do If You Can’t Afford a Dentist? It’s generally best to take whatever steps you can to fit dentistry into your budget. Dental issues that are ignored for too long tend to grow worse over time, which means more expensive treatments might be required in the future if you don’t get the care you need now. Taking advantage of your dental insurance benefits can help make a wide variety of dental procedures more affordable. (Our dental practice gladly takes many different PPO dental plans.) In situations where you may benefit from breaking up the cost of your care, you can apply for a CareCredit financing plan that lets you pay in monthly installments. Conveniently Located Near You Situated just north of I-10 on McDowell Road, we are close to many restaurants, including Red Robin and PF Chang’s in Palm Place Plaza. Whether you need to ask a question, make an appointment, or come visit us, we can’t wait to assist you any way we can!
